findings.source_quote: Adore th’ almighty King of Kings!
findings.suggested_fix: Replace translated phrase “崇拜万能的万王之王！” with “崇拜全能的万王之王！” to better reflect the conventional theological term for God in Chinese and preserve the sense of “almighty.” Preserve the surrounding <strong> tags and line breaks exactly.

findings.source_quote: The Dayspring shineth from on high,
findings.suggested_fix: Consider rendering “Dayspring” as “黎明之光” or “晨曦” rather than “昼光” to better convey the biblical/poetic sense of a Messianic dawn and to match the poem’s tone. Example replacement: “黎明之光自高天照耀,” keeping original line breaks and <strong> tags.
